beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Count with us. Each fact lights its twin. The ones.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One, Two, Three, Four, Five, Six, Seven, Eight, Nine, Ten, Eleven, Twelve.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Any number of ones is that number.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Now the twos.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Two, Four, Six, Eight, Ten, Twelve, Fourteen, Sixteen, Eighteen, Twenty, Twenty-two, Twenty-four.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Twos: double.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Now the threes.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Three, Six, Nine, Twelve, Fifteen, Eighteen, Twenty-one, Twenty-four, Twenty-seven, Thirty, Thirty-three, Thirty-six.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Now the fours.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Four, Eight, Twelve, Sixteen, Twenty, Twenty-four, Twenty-eight, Thirty-two, Thirty-six, Forty, Forty-four, Forty-eight.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Fours: double, then double again.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Now the fives.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Five, Ten, Fifteen, Twenty, Twenty-five, Thirty, Thirty-five, Forty, Forty-five, Fifty, Fifty-five, Sixty.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Fives end in five, zero, five, zero, like minutes on a clock.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Now the sixes.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Six, Twelve, Eighteen, Twenty-four, Thirty, Thirty-six, Forty-two, Forty-eight, Fifty-four, Sixty, Sixty-six, Seventy-two.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Sixes: five groups and one more.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Now the sevens. Look: six answers are already here.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Seven, Fourteen, Twenty-one, Twenty-eight, Thirty-five, Forty-two, Forty-nine, Fifty-six, Sixty-three, Seventy, Seventy-seven, Eighty-four.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Now the eights.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Eight, Sixteen, Twenty-four, Thirty-two, Forty, Forty-eight, Fifty-six, Sixty-four, Seventy-two, Eighty, Eighty-eight, Ninety-six.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Eights: double, double, double.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Five facts to keep.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Six times seven is forty-two.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Six times eight is forty-eight.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Seven times seven is forty-nine.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Seven times eight is fifty-six.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Five, six, seven, eight: fifty-six is seven times eight.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Eight times eight is sixty-four.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Same forty-eight dots.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Cut across. Half as many rows; twice as many in each.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Again. Half one, double the other.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Still forty-eight.

do.text: Half the rows · double each row

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Now the nines.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Nine, Eighteen, Twenty-seven, Thirty-six, Forty-five, Fifty-four, Sixty-three, Seventy-two, Eighty-one, Ninety, Ninety-nine, One hundred eight.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Nines: ten groups, take away one. Seventy minus seven is sixty-three.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Now the tens.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Ten, Twenty, Thirty, Forty, Fifty, Sixty, Seventy, Eighty, Ninety, One hundred, One hundred ten, One hundred twenty.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Tens: write the number, then a zero.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Now the elevens.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Eleven, Twenty-two, Thirty-three, Forty-four, Fifty-five, Sixty-six, Seventy-seven, Eighty-eight, Ninety-nine, One hundred ten, One hundred twenty-one, One hundred thirty-two.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Elevens repeat the digit through ninety-nine; then one hundred ten, one hundred twenty-one, one hundred thirty-two.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Now the twelves.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Twelve, Twenty-four, Thirty-six, Forty-eight, Sixty, Seventy-two, Eighty-four, Ninety-six, One hundred eight, One hundred twenty, One hundred thirty-two, One hundred forty-four.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Twelves: ten groups and two more.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The table is full. Down the diagonal: a number times itself.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One. Four. Nine. Sixteen. Twenty-five. Thirty-six. Forty-nine. Sixty-four. Eighty-one. One hundred. One hundred twenty-one. One hundred forty-four.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Those facts are their own twins. Play it again, and say it with us.

do.text: Your turn: say it with us
